comment: Turns Fixed Product Tax (FPT) calculation on or off.
modal: When set to **Yes**, Fixed Product Tax (FPT) is calculated and applied to products that carry an FPT attribute. Can be set per website, so FPT can be active on one website and off on another.

comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown in product lists.
modal: Controls the way FPT amounts appear in category and other product lists (for example shown separately or rolled into the price). Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown on the product view page.
modal: Controls the way FPT amounts are displayed on the product detail page. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown in sales documents.
modal: Controls the way FPT amounts are displayed in sales areas such as the cart, orders and invoices. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

comment: How Fixed Product Tax amounts are shown in emails.
modal: Controls the way FPT amounts are displayed in transactional emails. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether tax is also applied on top of the Fixed Product Tax amount.
modal: When **Yes**, regular tax is calculated on the FPT amount as well as on the product price. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether the Fixed Product Tax is included in the order subtotal.
modal: When **Yes**, FPT is added into the order subtotal rather than shown as a separate amount. Applies only when **Enable FPT** is Yes. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of the Fixed Product Tax line among the order totals.
modal: A sort-order number that sets where the Fixed Product Tax line appears relative to the other totals (subtotal, shipping, tax, etc.). Can differ per website.
